timeline.text: Every new lesson on my kids' TV wall meant me hand-coding a new React screen — and no way to check it matched the lesson before they saw it.
Now each lesson is written as a script — a set of timed steps an AI puts together on its own.
Every script gets checked twice, once before the wall shows it and once again on the screen itself.
In a single week, hand-coded lesson types went from three to eight.
